name: @moyarich/workspace-tools
description: Reusable GitHub Actions workflows and CLI tooling for Node.js workspaces, releases, publishing, and repository automation.
author: Moya Richards

scripts.build:actions: vite build --config vite.actions.config.ts && npm run build:clis
scripts.build:clis: vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode issue-dependency-tree && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode discover-packages && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode workspace-release && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode workspace-publish && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode workspace-dependency-check && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode workspace-package-lock && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --mode workspace-release-identity
